WITH cust AS (
    SELECT CustomerKey,
           uniqExact(SalesOrderNumber) AS order_cnt,
           sum(SalesAmount) / nullIf(uniqExact(SalesOrderNumber), 0) AS aov
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
thr AS (
    SELECT quantileExact(0.9)(order_cnt) AS order_thr,
           quantileExact(0.9)(aov) AS aov_thr
    FROM cust
),
picked AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerKey, c.order_cnt, c.aov
    FROM cust c
    CROSS JOIN thr t
    WHERE c.order_cnt >= t.order_thr
      AND c.aov >= t.aov_thr
)
SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY p.order_cnt DESC, p.aov DESC, p.CustomerKey) AS `名次`,
       p.CustomerKey AS `客户键`,
       multiIf(d.FirstName IS NULL OR d.FirstName = '' OR d.FirstName = 'Not Provided'
               OR d.LastName IS NULL OR d.LastName = '' OR d.LastName = 'Not Provided',
               concat('客户 ', toString(p.CustomerKey)),
               concat(d.FirstName, ' ', d.LastName)) AS `客户`,
       p.order_cnt AS `订单数`,
       p.aov AS `客单价`
FROM picked p
LEFT JOIN retail.DimCustomer d ON p.CustomerKey = d.CustomerKey
ORDER BY p.order_cnt DESC, p.aov DESC, p.CustomerKey

        f.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS amt,
        sum(f.ReturnAmount) AS ret
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    WHERE f.DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01') AND f.DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')
    GROUP BY f.ProductKey
)
SELECT
    ifNull(c.ProductCategoryName, '未知') AS ProductCategoryName,
    sum(s.amt) - sum(s.ret) AS NetSalesAmount
FROM s
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS sc ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = sc.ProductSubcategoryKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS c ON sc.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY ifNull(c.ProductCategoryName, '未知')
ORDER BY NetSalesAmount DESC
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        uniqExact(SalesOrderNumber) AS Orders,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        Orders,
        SalesAmount,
        SalesAmount / nullIf(Orders, 0) AS AOV,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY Orders DESC, CustomerKey ASC) AS OrderRank,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY SalesAmount / nullIf(Orders, 0) DESC, CustomerKey ASC) AS AOVRank,
        count() OVER () AS TotalCustomers
    FROM per_customer
)
SELECT
    r.CustomerKey AS `客户编码`,
    multiIf(
        c.FirstName = 'Not Provided' OR c.LastName = 'Not Provided' OR c.FirstName = '' OR c.LastName = '',
        toString(r.CustomerKey),
        concat(c.FirstName, ' ', c.LastName)
    ) AS `客户名称`,
    r.Orders AS `订单数`,
    round(r.AOV, 2) AS `客单价`,
    r.OrderRank AS `订单数排名`,
    r.AOVRank AS `客单价排名`
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON r.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
WHERE r.OrderRank <= toUInt64(ceil(r.TotalCustomers * 0.1))
  AND r.AOVRank <= toUInt64(ceil(r.TotalCustomers * 0.1))
ORDER BY r.OrderRank ASC, r.AOVRank ASC
turns.assumption: 前 10% 按全部客户数向上取整，用 row_number 按指标降序排名（并列时按 CustomerKey 升序打破并列）；订单数为去重线上订单号数，客单价为销售额÷去重订单数，均含只有退货行的订单。

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        ifNull(c.ProductCategoryName, '未知') AS CategoryName,
        toYear(f.DateKey) AS Y,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS Revenue,
        sum(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalCost) AS GrossProfit
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS s
        ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS c
        ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) IN (2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY CategoryName, Y
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        CategoryName,
        sumIf(Revenue, Y = 2008) AS Revenue2008,
        sumIf(Revenue, Y = 2009) AS Revenue2009,
        sumIf(GrossProfit, Y = 2008) AS GrossProfit2008,
        sumIf(GrossProfit, Y = 2009) AS GrossProfit2009
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY CategoryName
)
SELECT
    CategoryName AS `品类`,
    Revenue2008 AS `2008年营收`,
    Revenue2009 AS `2009年营收`,
    Revenue2009 - Revenue2008 AS `营收增加额`,
    (Revenue2009 - Revenue2008) / nullIf(Revenue2008, 0) AS `营收增长率`,
    GrossProfit2008 AS `2008年毛利`,
    GrossProfit2009 AS `2009年毛利`,
    GrossProfit2008 - GrossProfit2009 AS `毛利减少额`,
    (GrossProfit2009 - GrossProfit2008) / nullIf(GrossProfit2008, 0) AS `毛利变化率`
FROM pivoted
WHERE Revenue2009 > Revenue2008
  AND GrossProfit2009 < GrossProfit2008
ORDER BY CategoryName
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
turns.assumption: 未说明渠道，按约定使用线上销售明细（FactOnlineSales）；未登记产品归入「未知」品类。

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        ifNull(c.ProductCategoryName, '未知') AS ProductCategoryName,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2008) AS revenue_2008,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009) AS revenue_2009,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2008) - sumIf(f.TotalCost, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2008) AS gross_profit_2008,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009) - sumIf(f.TotalCost, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009) AS gross_profit_2009
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory s ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory c ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) IN (2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY ProductCategoryName
)
SELECT
    ProductCategoryName,
    revenue_2009 - revenue_2008 AS revenue_change,
    (revenue_2009 - revenue_2008) / nullIf(revenue_2008, 0) AS revenue_change_pct,
    gross_profit_2009 - gross_profit_2008 AS gross_profit_change,
    (gross_profit_2009 - gross_profit_2008) / nullIf(gross_profit_2008, 0) AS gross_profit_change_pct
FROM base
WHERE revenue_2009 > revenue_2008
  AND gross_profit_2009 < gross_profit_2008
ORDER BY ProductCategoryName
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
turns.assumption: 未说明渠道，按语义层默认使用线上销售（FactOnlineSales）；毛利按销售额−总成本计算，未登记产品归入未知品类组。

    GROUP BY f.StoreKey, toMonth(f.DateKey)

segments AS (

        min(m) AS start_m,

        FROM retail.FactSalesQuota AS q
        INNER JOIN retail.DimScenario AS sc
            ON q.ScenarioKey = sc.ScenarioKey
        WHERE sc.ScenarioName = 'Budget'
          AND q.DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
          AND q.DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-01')
        GROUP BY q.StoreKey
    ),
    monthly_actual AS
    (
        SELECT
            f.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
            toStartOfMonth(f.DateKey) AS mon,
            sum(f.SalesAmount) AS actual_sales
        FROM retail.FactSales AS f
        WHERE f.DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
          AND f.DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')
        GROUP BY f.StoreKey, toStartOfMonth(f.DateKey)
    ),
    store_month AS
    (
        SELECT
            t.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
            st.StoreName AS StoreName,
            m.mon AS mon,
            t.monthly_target AS monthly_target,
            coalesce(a.actual_sales, 0) AS actual_sales
        FROM monthly_target AS t
        INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS st
            ON t.StoreKey = st.StoreKey
        CROSS JOIN months AS m
        LEFT JOIN monthly_actual AS a
            ON t.StoreKey = a.StoreKey
           AND m.mon = a.mon
    ),
    failed_months AS
    (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            StoreName,
            mon,
            monthly_target,
            actual_sales
        FROM store_month
        WHERE actual_sales < monthly_target
    ),
    runs AS
    (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            StoreName,
            mon,
            monthly_target,
            actual_sales,
            month_idx - rn AS grp
        FROM
        (
            SELECT
                StoreKey,
                StoreName,
                mon,
                monthly_target,
                actual_sales,
                toInt32(dateDiff('month', toDate('2009-01-01'), mon)) AS month_idx,
                toInt32(row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY StoreKey ORDER BY mon)) AS rn
            FROM failed_months

    )

    StoreKey,
    StoreName,
    min(mon) AS start_month,
    max(mon) AS end_month,
    count() AS consecutive_months
FROM runs
GROUP BY StoreKey, StoreName, grp
HAVING count() >= 3
ORDER BY StoreName, start_month;

        nullIf(
            sqrt(
                (sum(n) * sum(sxx) - sum(sx) * sum(sx)) *

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        ProductKey,
        argMax(OnHandQuantity, DateKey) AS OnHandQuantity,
        argMax(SafetyStockQuantity, DateKey) AS SafetyStockQuantity
    FROM retail.FactInventory
    WHERE DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')
    GROUP BY StoreKey, ProductKey

product_level AS (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,

    row_number() OVER (

    coalesce(dp.ProductName, toString(p.ProductKey)) AS `产品名称`,

    p.Difference AS `差额`
FROM product_level p
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct dp
    ON p.ProductKey = dp.ProductKey
ORDER BY p.Difference DESC, `产品名称` ASC, p.ProductKey ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH category_daily AS (
    SELECT
        f.DateKey AS DateKey,
        coalesce(pc.ProductCategoryName, '未知') AS ProductCategoryName,
        d.IsWorkDay AS IsWorkDay,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS DailySalesAmount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
        ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
        ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    GROUP BY f.DateKey, ProductCategoryName, d.IsWorkDay
),
category_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ProductCategoryName,
        avgIf(DailySalesAmount, IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd') AS AvgWeekendDailySales,
        avgIf(DailySalesAmount, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay') AS AvgWorkdayDailySales,
        countIf(IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd') AS WeekendDays,
        countIf(IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay') AS WorkdayDays
    FROM category_daily
    GROUP BY ProductCategoryName
)
SELECT
    ProductCategoryName,
    AvgWeekendDailySales,
    AvgWorkdayDailySales,
    AvgWeekendDailySales - AvgWorkdayDailySales AS DifferenceAmount,
    100 * (AvgWeekendDailySales - AvgWorkdayDailySales) / nullIf(AvgWorkdayDailySales, 0) AS DifferencePct,
    WeekendDays,
    WorkdayDays
FROM category_avg
ORDER BY ProductCategoryName
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1;

WITH daily AS (
    SELECT
        c.ProductCategoryName AS category,
        d.IsWorkDay AS daytype,
        f.DateKey AS dk,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS amt
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
        ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS s
        ON s.ProductSubcategoryKey = p.ProductSubcategoryKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS c
        ON c.ProductCategoryKey = s.ProductCategoryKey
    GROUP BY category, daytype, dk
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        countIf(daytype = 'WeekEnd') AS weekend_days,
        countIf(daytype = 'WorkDay') AS workday_days,
        avgIf(amt, daytype = 'WorkDay') AS workday_daily_avg,
        avgIf(amt, daytype = 'WeekEnd') AS weekend_daily_avg
    FROM daily
    GROUP BY category
)
SELECT
    category,
    weekend_days,
    workday_days,
    workday_daily_avg,
    weekend_daily_avg,
    weekend_daily_avg - workday_daily_avg AS diff_amount,
    (weekend_daily_avg - workday_daily_avg) / nullIf(workday_daily_avg, 0) * 100 AS diff_pct
FROM agg
ORDER BY diff_amount DESC
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1

WITH daily AS (
    SELECT
        d.IsWorkDay AS day_type,
        coalesce(nullIf(c.ProductCategoryName, ''), '未知') AS category_name,
        f.DateKey AS sale_date,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS amt
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
        ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS s
        ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS c
        ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey
    GROUP BY
        d.IsWorkDay,
        coalesce(nullIf(c.ProductCategoryName, ''), '未知'),
        f.DateKey
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        category_name,
        avgIf(amt, day_type = 'WorkDay') AS weekday_avg,
        avgIf(amt, day_type = 'WeekEnd') AS weekend_avg,
        countIf(day_type = 'WorkDay') AS weekday_days,
        countIf(day_type = 'WeekEnd') AS weekend_days
    FROM daily
    GROUP BY category_name
)
SELECT
    category_name AS `品类`,
    round(weekday_avg, 2) AS `工作日日均销售额`,
    round(weekend_avg, 2) AS `周末日均销售额`,
    round(weekend_avg - weekday_avg, 2) AS `周末高出的金额`,
    round((weekend_avg - weekday_avg) / nullIf(weekday_avg, 0) * 100, 2) AS `周末高出的百分比`,
    weekday_days AS `工作日天数`,
    weekend_days AS `周末天数`
FROM agg
ORDER BY category_name
